title: The Space page editor's Publish button recovers from a failed call

source.ref: Space function scan 2026-11-17 (project thread: Trace every Space feature end to end)

detail: handlePublish (and the Reset handler) await the server action with no try. A thrown call (network drop, server error past the action's own error result) leaves the button on Publishing... with no way to retry short of a reload, and the server's error text is never shown. Fix: try/finally back to the error state, and show the returned error.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
